## Captions to Markdown 🎬

Save any video's closed captions as clean, readable paragraphs with no timestamps. Works on YouTube, Vimeo and most HTML5 players, including players embedded from other sites.

**Also new:** a fresh icon, and the popup footer stays on one line.

### Install

1. Download **page-to-markdown-v1.5.0.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, switch on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.

Updating? Unzip over your old folder and click the reload icon on the extension's card.

Full history in the [changelog](https://github.com/cobuild-labs/page-to-markdown/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Enjoying it? [Buy me a coffee ☕](https://buy.stripe.com/28EbJ2bJNeLS1FrfZ100002)
